decisions.briefing: Market was neutral today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no strong risk-on confirmation across the candidate list. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we held rather than forcing a buy. All 7 existing positions are left untouched, with stop-loss and profit-target rules continuing to run automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%, reflecting a broadly neutral, low-conviction trading session rather than any single decisive catalyst. Momentum candidates on the screener remain mostly in overbought RSI territory, suggesting the recent rally has room to cool before a fresh entry point emerges. Without a clear volume-confirmed breakout or risk-on signal, the market appears to be consolidating.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢偏軟，納斯達克指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.1%，整體屬於中性、缺乏方向性的交投格局，並無單一明確的市場催化因素。篩選名單中的動能股多數RSI已進入超買區間，顯示近期升勢或需先消化整理，才有更佳的進場時機。在缺乏成交量確認的突破或風險偏好轉強訊號下，市場暫時呈現盤整格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today the portfolio's cash balance was below the minimum deployment threshold and the market showed no decisive risk-on signal, so holding cash was the disciplined choice rather than forcing a trade just to stay busy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指預留在場邊、等待真正好機會出現時才動用的現金。今日投資組合的現金餘額低於最低部署門檻，市場亦未出現明確的風險偏好轉強訊號，因此按兵不動、保留現金才是紀律性的選擇，而非為了「有動作」而勉強交易。
